content: Fractional Kelly (25-50% of full Kelly, i.e. quarter- or half-Kelly) is the industry-standard practitioner adjustment -- full Kelly is mathematically optimal for long-run growth but produces drawdowns most traders cannot tolerate and assumes exact, error-free win-rate/payoff-ratio estimates. Half-Kelly captures ~75% of the growth rate at ~25% of the variance. Kelly inputs must come from a statistically significant, out-of-sample (not in-sample backtest) trade sample; broker margin/leverage constraints act as a hard ceiling on the resulting position size regardless of what Kelly recommends.
